notes.title: A Sneak Peak at ACT 4!
notes.content:
THE NEXT UPDATE WILL CONTAIN

 A fully complete Act 4 "SATANIC HATRED"
 New unique, complex enemies and attack patterns
 A final boss with full lore, a cinematic cutscene, and a fight far greater than anything seen before in this game. The final level will also be physically twice the size of a normal level


Other Small Changes Include

 Official Act Names
 Polished level selection menu
 A variety of bug fixes and performance improvements


Act 5
Act 5 is still being worked on, and will likely release in the summer of 2023
I want to take my time to make it as best as it can possibly be, find more ways to make unique levels, and create a final boss that is extremely challenging but incredibly fair and satisfying. 

Thank you all so much for playing, and I hope you have a wonderful day!

Sincerely,
Caden

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Christmas Update (Update 1.2.7)
notes.content:
CHANGES IN THE CHRISTMAS UPDATE 

FROST - First Level of ACT 4

 New Frozen Planet
 Glacial Behemoth Boss
 More of ACT 4 is coming soon!


New Features

 Most enemies and bosses now have Santa Hats during December!
 The texture of the selected level's boss is now displayed in the level menu
 Changed Act numbers from roman numerals to regular numbers
 Added Loading Screen
 Changed texture of the second Titan King boss
 Holding down buttons in the menu now automatically cycles through
 When killed, instead of disappearing, the player now spins out and crashes
 The flame of the player ship is now animated
 Polished Mucus boss and changed the color of bombs to gray in error level


Bug Fixes

 Fixed MAJOR rendering bug that occurred on smaller monitors
 Fixed centering of the settings menus
 Fixed Controller Joystick not working in the pause menu
 Fixed Controller Drift
 Minor balancing of Typhon boss
 Fixed rendering issue with boss bars
 Fixed a bug that caused controller input not to go through until a button was pressed


Happy Holidays Everyone!
Sincerely, Caden

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.6
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.6

Infinity

 All-new infinite game mode
 Saves high score
 Average score indicator
 Random enemies
 Boss every 10 waves
 New secret boss that can randomly spawn above wave 30


Menu Changes

 Added the ability to switch between one of three saves
 More fluid menu movement
 All options are now capitalized

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.5
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.5

Checkpoints
Checkpoints will now appear before bosses, allowing you to respawn at the boss after death!
Quitting the level will reset the checkpoint.
A new challenge has been added that disables checkpoints!
In addition, the pause menu now allows you to return to the checkpoint or restart the level with one click!

Boss Bars
Bosses with two boss bars now have a visual indicator that there will be two main stages. Currently, this only applies to the Hellish Nightmare and the Sun Prison.

Small Changes/Bug Fixes
Fixed a rendering bug that showed the contents of previous levels for one frame.
The screen now fades in from black when starting the game or returning to the main menu.
Changed bomb texture.

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.4
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.4

Moving Background Textures
Similar to the star background, the backgrounds of planets and moons will now slowly slide down the screen. There is a new setting to turn this feature off for all backgrounds.

Small Changes/Bug Fixes
Fixed bug that unlocked acts before completing the previous ones.
Small performance improvements and code cleanup

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.3
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.3

Challenges
When completing a level with no damage taken, you will no longer be rewarded with gold text and gold coloring for the level. That now happens when you complete a level with every challenge activated.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that made The Rift level unplayable

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.2

Improved Bosses
Many bosses have been significantly improved, removing the randomness and improving overall fairness.

Pause Menu
A pause menu has been added. Press escape while in-game to use.

Small Changes
White Hole boss health has been halved, to make it less of a boss, and more of a transition into Act II.
Small technical changes, performance improvements and code cleanup

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
CHANGES IN PATCH 1.2.1

Discord Rich Presence
The level you are playing, its description, and the boss you are fighting will now show up on your Discord profile!

Fullscreen
The long-awaited feature has finally been added! You can now switch to full-screen mode in the options menu!

Small Fixes

 The attack speed of enemies that shoot red tracking bullets has been nerfed significantly
 Many performance enhancements, including an optimized settings menu.
 Code cleanup

notes.title: Galactic Explorers Update 1.2
notes.content:
1.2 PATCH NOTES

ACT III

Added Levels:

 Death
 Mucus
 Error
 Cilicia
 Heaven


Added Bosses

 Soul of Ares II
 Hideous Glob
 Glitch
 Typhon
 Gabriel


UPGRADES
Upgrades are a fun new way of adding progression to the game! You can unlock upgrades by progressing and completing levels. You can view your unlocked upgrades in the options menu.

Added Upgrades

 Gravity Device
 Tracker Bullets
 Laser Beam
 Fireballs


CHALLENGES
Challenges are a fun new way of adding difficulty to the game! You can toggle different challenges in the options menu, that will affect the difficulty of the game in different ways. (All challenges are off by default)

Added Challenges

 One HP Challenge
 No Upgrades Challenge

More challenges coming soon!

PARTICLES
Added particle effects that display when an entity is killed. The size of the enemy affects the amount displayed, and the type of enemy affects the color of the particles! There is also an option in settings to disable particles for performance purposes.

LEVEL UPDATES
A few waves of unique quad shooting enemies have been added to the Sludge level in Act II, to make the level more interesting.

CREDITS DISPLAY
The credits which display when you beat the game's final level have been updated to look and feel more polished and cinematic. Credits fade in one at a time instead of rolling. Credit music has also been changed.

SMALL CHANGES/BUG FIXES
Fixed a bug that made gameplay speed much slower on some computers.
The Hellish Nightmare boss now shoots bombs that look like mini skulls.
Embers (orange projectiles) are now rectangular and will rotate.
The Space Worm boss now shoots more colorful projectiles to make the fight more interesting.
Many more small changes have been made, but it's hard to keep track of all of them.
I'm surprised you read this far down the patch notes.

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content: In the final patch before release, a tutorial level has been added, and many bosses have been reworked so that the difficulty consistently increases throughout levels.

notes.title: Galactic Explorers - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: Previously when using a controller on the death/victory screen, it would say "Press X to Continue/Restart", however, X is the PS4 bind, so it confuses Xbox players. The game will now detect your controller and use its respective mapping.
